## Verification

- [ ] Backend tests (`cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. pytest -q`)
- [ ] Frontend build (`cd frontend && npm run build`)

- [ ] GPU host test (if GPU behavior changed; otherwise mark N/A)
- [ ] Docs and security implications reviewed
